title: Lamb Kebabs with Fresh Cucumber Salad
description: A refreshing summer dish with marinated lamb kebabs paired with a cool cucumber salad.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well.
Thread the marinated lamb, juicy tomatoes, and crisp cilantro onto skewers.
Brush the kebabs with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb reaches 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Meanwhile, combine sliced red onion, chopped tomatoes, and chopped cilantro in a bowl.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the salad and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the grilled kebabs with the cucumber salad on the side.
If using feta cheese, crumble it over the salad for an extra burst of flavor.
